findings: Empty-state 'New Deck' button not hidden on form open — when decks.length === 0 and showNewDeck becomes true, the empty-state block (and its button) remains visible alongside the inline form. Fold the form into the ternary so it replaces the empty-state block when showNewDeck is true.

Relief skips on rapid correct answers — setRelief(true) is a no-op when relief is already true, so the fog won't re-dim for a second consecutive correct answer within 1 s. Use a counter dependency (reliefCount) instead of a boolean.
